evals.prompt: Create a new user with email newanalyst@company.com and display name 'New Analyst', then confirm they were created successfully.
evals.expected_output: User created with correct email, displayName, and active: true. A follow-up verification confirms the user exists with correct state.
assertions: The agent includes the full SCIM schema ('urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User') in the create request body
After creating the user, the agent runs a verification step — either omni scim users-list with a filter or a get call — to confirm the user was created
The agent reports the user's ID or confirms active: true from the verification response rather than assuming success from the create response alone

evals.prompt: Give the 'Analytics Team' group view access to the dashboard with identifier '{{EVAL_DASHBOARD_PERMISSIONS}}'.
evals.expected_output: Document permissions updated so the Analytics Team group has view access. A verification step confirms the permission was applied.
assertions: The agent calls omni documents update-permission-settings (not update-permission) with the document identifier
The permission body includes a type field set to 'group' and an access field set to 'view'
The agent verifies the change by reading back the document permissions after setting them

evals.prompt: Set up a weekly email schedule for dashboard '{{EVAL_DASHBOARD_SCHEDULE}}' to send every Monday at 9am Pacific time as a PDF, and add team@company.com as a recipient.
evals.expected_output: Schedule created with correct frequency, day, hour, timezone, and format. Recipient added and verified.
assertions: The agent creates a schedule with frequency: weekly, dayOfWeek: monday, hour: 9, timezone: America/Los_Angeles, format: pdf
The agent adds team@company.com as a recipient using omni schedules add-recipients
The agent verifies the schedule and recipient were configured correctly by reading them back with omni schedules list and omni schedules recipients-get

evals.prompt: Set a user attribute 'region' to 'West Coast' for the user with email {{EVAL_EXISTING_USER}}.
evals.expected_output: User found by email, attribute set via SCIM update, and verification confirms the attribute was applied.
assertions: The agent first looks up the user by email using omni scim users-list with a filter before attempting to set the attribute
The SCIM update uses the Omni user attribute path format: urn:omni:params:1.0:UserAttribute:region
The agent verifies the attribute was set after the update
